app-title: Ekigo kya Bannapayiniya ba Afrika Eky'Ebyenjigiriza - Eby'ebweru
welcome-sub: Omulyango gw'okunyweza Afrika ng'okuyita mu Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Mu kujaguza Olunaku lwa Afrika olw'e 25, Pulogulaamu eno ey'okutendeka Pi Pioneers etongozeddwa)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Mu Kijjukizo Ky'Okwagala kya Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Ekigo kino Eky'Ebyenjigiriza kyawaddeyo eri mwannyina wange omukulu omwagalwa Christina Muzheki Manjengwa eyawummula ku 8 Ogusito 2026 era n'aziikibwa ku 11 Ogusito nga ye Ssabbiiti ya Bashujaa ba Zimbabwe.
Ok wagala kwo, obulombolombo bwo n'amaanyi go bikubiriza omulimu gwaffe ogw'okunyweza Afrika.
Emirembe gyonna mu mitima gyaffe. Wummula mu Maanyi, Mwannyina.
intro-p1: Pi Network ssente ya digito ne pulojekiti y'enkulaakulana y'ensi yonna eyakolebwa okufuula cryptocurrency etuukirika era ey'omugaso eri buli muntu.
intro-p2: Okwawukana ku cryptocurrencies ez'ennono ezitwala ebyuma by'okumukula eby'ebbeeyi, Pi Network esobozesa abantu ab'awamu okwetaba butereevu okuva ku masimu gaabwe.
intro-list:
• Zimba ebyenfuna bya digito ebigatta bonna nga tewali banki
  • Nyweza abantu ab'awamu mu nsi yonna n'okumukula kw'essimu
  • Ongera okukozesebwa kw'amazima ng'okuyita mu utilities ne DApps
  • Wagira obusuubuzi bw'omuntu ku muntu era okendeeze ku miwendo
  • Yatondwa Stanford PhDs - Dr Nicolas Kokkalis & Dr Chengdiao Fan
  • Abapayiniya abasoba mu Miliyoni 60 mu nsi yonna
ch1-p2: Omusomo 2: Weewandiise ne Facebook oba Essimu → Teeka koodi: CHIGALEX1 → Funa empeera ya 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Okumukula kwa buli lunaku: Dda buli maasa 24 onyige akabonye ka lumyansi okusobola okweyongera okumukula.
ch1-list2:
• Toskozesa linnya lya bwereere - lirina okukwatagana ne ID ya KYC
  • Tokolawo akawunti nnyingi - omuntu omu akawunti emu
  • Teekawo alamu y'okumukula buli maasa 24 okukuuma omutindo
  • Yingira mu nkulungo y'obukuumi oluvannyuma lw'ennaku 3 n'abantu 5 be wesiga
ch1-list:
• Tonda wallet ya Pi mu bukuumi
  • Maliriza 2FA
  • Maliriza KYC
  • Wetegeke olw'okukyuka kwa Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Obukuumi bwa wallet: TOGABANA bigambo byo 24 eby'ekisumuluzo! Ttiimu ya Pi Core TEKYA kusaba!
ch2: ESSUULA 2 — OKUSOMESA KWA WALLET YA PI
ch2-p1: Wallet yo eya Pi ye banka yo mu Pi Ecosystem. Ekwata ssente zo eza Pi mu bukuumi ku blockchain.
ch2-p2: Engeri y'okutonda: Ggulawo Pi Browser → Wallet → Tonda Wallet → KOPIYA ebigambo byo 24 → Bika offline mu bifo 2 eby'obukuumi.
ch2-p3: Okufuna Pi: Gabana aderesi yo eya bonna (etandika ne G...). Okutuma Pi: Teekayo aderesi y'omufunzi, teeka omuwendo, kakasa.
ch2-list:
• Wandiika passphrase ku lupapula, si kifaananyi
  • Bika mu bifo 2 eby'obukuumi eby'enjawulo (si ssimu yokka)
  • Gezaako ne 1 Pi ng'otonatuma muwendo munene
  • Kebera ennukuta 4 ezisooka ne 4 ezisembayo ez'aderesi buli kiseera
ch2a-p1: Okukozesebwa: Tandika n'omuwendo omutono ogw'okugezesa (1 Pi). Kakasa nti ennukuta 4 ezisooka ne 4 ezisembayo ez'aderesi zikwatagana. Togatta passphrase yo ku mukutu gwonna!
ch2a-p2: Dduyiro Obulamu: Mu kutenderezebwa kuno, tujja kukola demo ennamu ey'okutuma 1 Pi eri omupayiniya omulala okuzimba obwesige. Jjukira: Enkolagana za Blockchain tezizzibwa!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser ye ng'Google Play Store ya Pi. DApps ze pulogulaamu ezisaasaanyiziddwa ez'okukozesebwa okw'amazima — okuguza, ebyenjigiriza, emizannyo, obuweereza bwonna nga bukozesa Pi.
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Ekifo ky'okuguza ekinene ekya Pi
  • WorkforcePool - Emirimu gy'Abapayiniya
  • CareForPi - Obuyambi bw'ebyobulamu
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Ebyenjigiriza (App eno)
  • N'okukozesebwa okw'enjawulo okusoba mu 100
ch4-p1: Zuula bizinensi ezikkiriza Pi mu nsi yonna ku mapofpi.com. Wandikisa bizinensi yo wekka otandike okukkiriza Pi ku bintu n'obuweereza.
ch4-p2: Engeri y'Okuwandiisa Bizinensi Yo: Genda ku mapofpi.com → Yungibwa ne Pi Wallet → Yongera Bizinensi → Yongera ebifaananyi, ekifo, ebintu → Bakasitoma bajja kukuzuula! Eno y'engeri Afrika gy'eneekulembera okukkiriza Pi.
ch5-p1: Omugaso gw'Okukkiriziganya kw'Ensi Yonna (GCV) gukubiriza okukozesebwa okw'amazima. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Omugaso guno guzimbibwa bapayiniya abakozesa Pi mu by'obusuubuzi eby'amazima.
ch5-p2: Amakulu ga GCV: GCV si muwendo gwa kusuubula. Kuteekebwawo okukuuma omugaso gwa Pi nga tukozesa Pi mu kukkiriziganya okw'amaanyi mu kusuubula kwaffe. Bwe tukozesa Pi ku bintu eby'amazima ku GCV, tukola obwetaavu n'okukozesebwa. Kuno kuli kunyweza ebyenfuna kwa Afrika.
ch6-p1: Soma ekitabo kya Doris Yin eky'okutonda okukozesebwa n'okukula kw'enkulaakulana. Noonyereza, yiga, era yigiriza abalala — eno y'engeri gye tunywerezaamu Afrika.
ch6-p2: Omulimu Gwo ng'Omupayiniya wa Afrika: Yiga → Kola → Yigiriza abantu 2 → Abo 2 bayigiriza abalala 2. Eno y'engeri gye tutuukamu ku Milyon 1 Abafrika abasomeddwa! Wunula Whitepaper, soma, era ogabane okumanya buli lunaku.
final-msg: Afrika erina omukisa gw'okuba emu ku bitundu ebisinga amaanyi mu kukozesebwa okw'enkola mu Pi Ecosystem. Ffenna Twazimba. Ffenna Tusomesa.
